title: Casper and the Thorn
author: Coral Blackwood
blurb: Kestrel Ashgrove, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
